para_examples.original: I'm planning to price for value this season rather than chase volume, since steady margins serve everyone in this market better than a race to the bottom. Starting at a healthy level.
para_examples.delivered: This season I intend to set prices according to the value delivered rather than pursue sales volume, as stable margins benefit everyone in this market more than a race to the bottom does. I'll begin at a sound price point.

para_examples.original: I'm committed to holding a premium price point this season; quality and service are what we compete on, not discounts. We'd expect a stable, healthy market for everyone willing to do the same.
para_examples.delivered: I intend to maintain a premium price level this season, since we win on quality and service rather than on markdowns. We anticipate a steady, sound market for all who are prepared to take the same approach.

para_examples.original: I'm moving up toward a premium level this round, since quality and service are where we compete best. Healthy margins keep the market sound for everyone who holds the line.
para_examples.delivered: I'm raising my pricing to a higher tier in this cycle, because quality and service are where we win. Solid margins keep the market stable for everyone who maintains the same standard.
